paragraphs.text: Pontotoc High School’s college and career readiness classes heard this month from two people who help students take their next step after graduation. Maison Smith, the Ole Miss admissions counselor for Northeast Mississippi, explained university applications and scholarships. In a separate visit, Base Camp Coding Academy director Sean Ennis described a tuition-free route into software development in Water Valley.

For students considering Ole Miss in fall 2027, Jan. 10 is the deadline for both the Freshman Scholarship Application and the Competitive Academic Programs Application. The university advises applicants that processing an admission application can take three to four weeks at peak times once it has all the materials.

Smith also discussed housing, campus life and orientation, then quizzed students on their knowledge of Ole Miss. The university’s housing application for fall 2027 opened Oct. 1. Orientation registration opens in March.

Base Camp holds classes in person in Water Valley, so applicants must be able to commute. The academy says applicants can start without programming experience. To get an interview, a student must submit an application and have a former teacher, employer or another qualified person submit a nomination. Friends and relatives cannot serve as nominators.
